description: Reference da/dN versus delta_K points used to validate the LEFM Paris Law module.
validation_honesty_note: The two aluminium series are anchored independently of the material database, on the widely cited mid range value da/dN = 2.0e-7 m/cycle at delta_K = 10 MPa*sqrt(m) for 2024-T3 in laboratory air at R = 0.1, with the published Paris slope carried through the rest of the range. Comparing the material database against them is therefore a genuine external check. The bone and concrete series are the published Paris fits themselves, so for those two domains the comparison is a self consistency check of the rate evaluator and the integrator, not independent data validation. Part 2 should not report the bone and concrete numbers as external validation.

anchor.source: Commonly cited mid range growth rate for 2024-T3 sheet, R = 0.1, laboratory air. Equivalent to 2e-4 mm/cycle.

Al2024-T3_R0.1.source: Anchored Paris band, m = 3.5 from NASA/TM-2002-211428, C back solved from the delta_K = 10 anchor as 6.32e-11

Al7075-T6_R0.1.source: Anchored Paris band, m = 4.0, C back solved from da/dN = 2.5e-7 m/cycle at delta_K = 10

CorticalBone_R0.1.source: Caler and Carter 1989, Journal of Biomechanics 22(6):625-635, human cortical bone, physiologic conditions

Concrete_R0.1.source: Bazant and Xu 1991, ACI Materials Journal, size effect in fatigue fracture of concrete. Representative fit.

center_cracked_tension.F_formula: sqrt(sec(pi * a / W)) with a the half crack length and W the full plate width
center_cracked_tension.source: Feddersen 1966. Accuracy better than 0.3 percent for a/W below 0.35.
center_cracked_tension.check_points_note: a_over_b is the half crack length over the half width, so a/W_full is half of it. Values are sqrt(sec(pi*a/W_full)) evaluated exactly.

single_edge_notch_tension.source: Tada, Paris and Irwin, The Stress Analysis of Cracks Handbook, 3rd edition. Accuracy 0.5 percent for a/W below 0.6.

compact_tension.F_formula: ASTM E399 f(a/W) applied as K = P/(B*sqrt(W)) * f(a/W)
compact_tension.source: ASTM E399 standard test method for linear elastic plane strain fracture toughness.
